_about: How the dashboard groups the goal's promises into bars. The promises and their tests come from experiments/coverage.py; this file only says which bar each promise sits under and what to call it in plain words. A promise not listed here still appears, under 'Other promises'.

aspects.name: Staying alive
aspects.blurb: Eating and drinking, keeping warm, sleeping, sheltering, using what the world offers, dying and trying again.

aspects.name: Body
aspects.blurb: A human-like body that balances, knows where its own limbs are, and moves well in the world he survives in.

aspects.name: Senses
aspects.blurb: Every sense a human has, each one feeding the same brain and each one making a difference.

aspects.name: Memory
aspects.blurb: What he lived stays with him, across sleep and across death.

aspects.name: Learning
aspects.blurb: He explores because he wants to, keeps learning without forgetting, and carries what he knows to new places and new machines.

aspects.name: One brain
aspects.blurb: All his senses meet in one learning brain that acts at once when it can and thinks first when it must.

aspects.name: Words
aspects.blurb: He hears words and ties them to his own life, has a voice, takes advice, and can learn from being told.

aspects.name: People
aspects.blurb: He knows the people around him, learns whom to trust, and can be watched without it changing him.

aspects.name: Knowing his world
aspects.blurb: The handful of ideas that only living teaches: what is heavy, what is far, what is tiring, what is worth it.
